about: The calendar tools of a real MCP server, recorded after red line 2's phrases were chosen and not used to choose them: a held-out list. Each change to a calendar goes through one tool per kind with an action argument (create, update, delete, rsvp), so the tool names say nothing about it.

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.label: allow
tools.why: reads the calendars the user can access

tools.name: manage_event
tools.label: ask
tools.why: creates, updates or deletes an event, or answers an invitation (action create, update, delete or rsvp)

tools.name: manage_out_of_office
tools.label: ask
tools.why: creates, updates or deletes an out-of-office event, which other people see (action create, list, update or delete)

tools.name: manage_focus_time
tools.label: ask
tools.why: creates, updates or deletes focus-time blocks in a calendar others book against (action create, list, update or delete)

tools.name: create_calendar
tools.label: allow
tools.why: makes a new calendar that only its owner sees
